definitions.explanation: the ability to perceive things beyond the five physical senses

examples.japanese: {第|だい}{六感|ろっかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I sensed danger with my sixth sense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{第|だい}{六感|ろっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧。
examples.english: She has a sharp sixth sense.

examples.japanese: {六感|ろっかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じて→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to act on my intuition.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually said in full as {第|だい}{六感|ろっかん} (the sixth sense); bare {六感|ろっかん} is less common. It goes beyond the ⟦{五感|ごかん}→五感：05698_gokan⟧, the five senses of sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {第|だい}{六感|ろっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: one's sixth sense kicks in
- {第|だい}{六感|ろっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧: to have a sharp sixth sense
- {六感|ろっかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to trust one's intuition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{直感|ちょっかん}→直感：07624_chokkan⟧: intuition — the everyday word, with no suggestion of the paranormal
- ⟦{勘|かん}→勘：02149_kan⟧: hunch, gut feeling — casual (⟦{勘|かん}→勘：02149_kan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧, to have good instincts)
